title: Trivariate Hypergeometric Series Formulas for Pure Partition Functions of Multiple $3$-SLE$_κ$
summary: Pure partition functions of multiple SLE are characterized by null-state partial differential equations, Möbius covariance, and boundary asymptotics. After quotienting by Möbius covariance, the case of three curves is the first genuinely multivariable one: the moduli space has three independent variables, naturally represented by the three unoriented cross-ratios of the three pairs of links.
